messages:
Leo M: Hi! On day 3 and trying to update the Eng first-week template but the Notion page is locked. It shows 'Workspace owner change in progress'. Who do I ping for edits during the migration?
Priya V: welcome Leo :wave: We just moved the canonical workspace to a new owner and permissions are being re-applied. Short-term option: duplicate the template into 'Docs Drafts (personal)' and either 1) invite docs-bot to create a PR, or 2) use the docs-cli to push a contribution.
Leo M: docs-cli? I haven't used that. Is that internal?
Anil (Docs): Hey Leo 60a: docs-cli is our small tool to package Notion pages as markdown and open a GH PR when Notion access is flaky. Install via pip: `pip install redwood-docs-cli`. Example usage: `redwood-docs create-pr --page "New Hire - First Week" --workspace "Docs Drafts" --note "minor updates to links"`. It will upload assets and open a PR to docs-templates.
Taylor (IT): Quick note: while the workspace transfer completes, we intentionally set most team pages to view-only to avoid edit conflicts. If it's urgent, fill this short escalation form: https://forms.redwood.internal/it-access?urgent=notion-migration and tag your manager. We'll grant temporary page-level edit to the page owner.
Leo M: thanks. I tried duplicating but 'Docs Drafts' isn't in my workspace list.
Priya V: right 17 we create 'Docs Drafts' as a shared sandbox. Anil, can you invite Leo to Docs Drafts?
Anil (Docs): Invited Leo to Docs Drafts. Also note: when you duplicate, choose 'Duplicate with subpages' so the CLI captures the full structure.
Docs-bot: Reminder: to submit a Notion draft via docs-bot, Share the draft page and invite docs-bot@redwood with a short PR description. Docs-bot will create a GitHub PR against `docs-templates` and tag the Docs Fellows.
Leo M: invited docs-bot and ran the CLI command. It failed with `NotionIntegrationError: token missing`. Do I need a Notion integration token?
Anil (Docs): Good catch. For CLI you can either use your Notion session (SSO) or a temporary integration token we generate for contributors. If you prefer the token route, request it here: https://forms.redwood.internal/docs/integration-token (include page path and manager). Token expiry defaults to 24h.
Taylor (IT): We audit integration tokens, so include the reason and manager approval. If you supplied manager: Priya V, we can fast-track.
Leo M: submitted token request, manager: Priya V. Also left a PR note that this is a migration-era edit.
Priya V: approved. Thanks Leo. Anil, can you watch the PR and ensure merges sync to the new workspace?
Anil (Docs): Will do. Our migration tooling will attempt to re-link the merged page into the canonical workspace. If there are broken embeds (Figma/Loom) after migration we may follow up to reattach.
Leo M: one more Q: naming conventions — should I keep the original "[SWE]  First Week" title or add a migration suffix?
Anil (Docs): Keep the original title. In the PR description add `migration-era: true` so Fellows know it's during transfer. Don't create a duplicate top-level page unless it's a bespoke team doc.
DevEx Bot: Onboarding checklist reminder: step "Notion edits during migration" is marked as special-case. If you used docs-cli or docs-bot, reply with `docs-submitted: YES` to mark the checklist.
Leo M: docs-submitted: YES. Thanks everyone, I see the PR opened and Anil already left a review comment. Appreciate the quick flow!
Anil (Docs): Reviewing now. Welcome again :tada:
Taylor (IT): Token issued, watch expiry and rotate if you need more time. Ping me if SSO behaves weird during migration.
Leo M: merged and synced. All good now. Thanks team!
